name: UPG-VPP (User Plane Gateway based on VPP)
what_it_is: An out-of-tree VPP plugin implementing a GTP-U user plane per 3GPP TS 23.214 and TS 29.244 Release 15, usable as a 5G UPF, PGW-U, or TDF-U. It is used in production by telecom operators alongside the erGW GGSN/PGW.
components: VPP (fd.io vector packet processor) as the data-plane runtime
upf-plugin: the UPG out-of-tree VPP plugin (C, built as a .deb)
PFCP server: handles 3GPP TS 29.244 session control signalling
ADF (Application Detection Framework): L7 regex + IP filter-based traffic classification
TCP proxy: connection splicing for URL-based app detection (configurable MSS)
Go E2E test framework (Ginkgo/Gomega): spawns VPP in network namespaces and drives PFCP + traffic
IPFIX exporter: flow record export on port 4739
govpp binary API bindings: used by E2E tests to call VPP APIs directly
protocols: GTP-U (3GPP TS 29.281) — encapsulation/decapsulation of user-plane traffic
PFCP (3GPP TS 29.244) — session establishment, modification, deletion, reporting
IPv4 and IPv6 — both inner (UE) and outer (transport) addressing
ICMP / ICMPv6 (ping traffic generation in tests)
GTP-U extensions (sequence numbers, N-PDU, extension headers)
measurement: Usage Reporting Rules (URR): volume-based and duration-based measurement per PFCP session
Monitoring time and quota validity time (VTime) per URR
Linked Usage Reports and PFCP Session Reports
Volume quota enforcement (triggers session report when threshold crossed)
IPFIX flow records exported to collector on port 4739 with configurable templates
VPP CLI: 'show upf flows' for live flow state inspection
configuration: VPP startup config (generated from Go template): unix socket paths, CPU core pinning, heap size, plugin list, buffer size, session layer, logging level
Network Work Interfaces (NWI): named VRF-backed network contexts (cp, epc/access, sgi, core)
PFCP endpoint: 'upf pfcp endpoint ip <ip> vrf <id>'
GTP-U endpoint: 'upf gtpu endpoint ip[6] <ip> nwi <name> teid <mask>'
Node identity: 'upf node-id fqdn <name>' or 'upf node-id ip4 <ip>'
TDF uplink table: 'upf tdf ul table vrf <id> ip4|ip6 table-id <id>' and 'upf tdf ul enable ip4|ip6 <iface>'
ADF application definitions: 'adf create application name <APP> [proxy]', L7 regex rules, IP filter rules
PFCP FIFO size: 'upf pfcp server set fifo-size <kib>'
UDP MTU override: 'udp { mtu <value> }' in VPP startup to avoid UDP splitting
Heap size: set in VPP startup (default 1 GiB); cannot be expanded at runtime
Multicore mode: worker core assignment in VPP startup; E2E flag E2E_MULTICORE
fault_injection: GTP-U extension header injection via TPDUHook (sequence numbers, N-PDU, custom ext header type 0x32)
Corrupt GTP-U datagram injection via GTPURawHook (broken extension header length = 0) at configurable frequency (every 13th datagram)
Connection flood test (verifyConnFlood) to stress PFCP and data-plane under load
PDR replacement mid-session (describePDRReplacement) to test rule hot-swap
MTU-edge cases: small packet / fragmentation boundary tests (describeMTU)
NAT pool exhaustion / NAT behaviour tests (describeNAT, TDF mode only, IPv4 only)
E2E_PAUSE_ON_ERROR: pause VPP process on first test failure for interactive inspection
E2E_GDBSERVER: run VPP under gdbserver for attaching a debugger
modes: PGW mode (UPGModePGW): GTP-U encap/decap between access (grx) and SGi, IPv4 and IPv6
TDF mode (UPGModeTDF): transparent traffic detection without GTP-U tunnelling, IPv4 and IPv6
GTP Proxy mode (UPGModeGTPProxy): relay GTP-U between access and core NWIs, IPv4 and IPv6
Debug build vs release build: controlled by BUILD_TYPE=debug|release make variable
Interrupt mode vs polling mode: poll-sleep-usec in VPP startup toggles interrupt-driven scheduling
Single-core vs multicore: E2E_MULTICORE flag enables a second worker core in tests
constraints: Buffer Action Rules (BAR) are not implemented
QoS Enforcement Rule (QER) is not implemented
FAR action with LI (Lawful Intercept) destination is not implemented
Ethernet bearer support is not implemented
PFCP error handling is incomplete — errors in Sx procedures may not be properly propagated
VPP heap cannot be expanded beyond the initial size (default 1 GiB); large deployments must pre-configure a larger heap
VPP cannot chain buffers for IP fragments, so IP fragments larger than ~2 KiB cannot be produced unless buffer size is increased
VPP IP reassembly is limited to 8 fragments (patched from upstream default of 3); large PFCP datagrams may still exceed this
PFCP FIFO default size is 64 KiB; high-rate PFCP traffic can overflow it
UDP datagrams >1500 bytes are split by default (not IP-fragmented); requires 'udp { mtu }' workaround
Zero UDP checksum bug on PFCP Session Modification Responses for IPv6 PFCP endpoints (workaround: use IPv4 PFCP endpoint)
Built and tested only on Linux (Ubuntu/Debian); no Windows support
CI runs only for pushes to branches within the repository itself (no fork CI)
Per-commit Docker images expire after 7 days
docker_services: Build environment container ('make buildenv'): Ubuntu/Debian-based image containing VPP build dependencies, Go toolchain, clang, cmake; mounts project source at /src
UPG release/debug image ('make image'): final Docker image containing the upf-plugin .deb installed on top of a VPP base image
VPP base image (vpp-base / fpp-vpp): travelping fork of upstream VPP used as the base layer
E2E test runner: VPP is launched as a subprocess inside the build container, not as a separate Docker service; network namespaces are used instead of Docker networking
notable_absences: No docker-compose.yml — the project uses Makefile + a single build/test container, not a multi-service Compose stack
No Kubernetes manifests or Helm charts in the repository
No SMF/AMF/control-plane simulator included — E2E tests implement a minimal PFCP client in Go directly
No RADIUS or Diameter AAA integration
No persistent storage or database component
No REST or gRPC management API — all configuration is via VPP CLI or PFCP
